name: Old Ghost Road

photo_reason: Track along the Bald Hill ridge (Schwede66, 2018, CC BY-SA 4.0); the trail itself, in crop.

name: Lake Brunner

photo_reason: Still lake with the south shore mountain (MRD 01, 2021, CC BY 4.0, categorised Lake Brunner); clear and recognisable.

name: Carters Beach
objection: Wikivoyage Westport lists it (wide sand, swimming, surfing); second-tier beach, one counted source. Keep (beaches named by a real source are not rejected).

photo.file: Carters Beach, West Coast, New Zealand.jpg

photo_reason: Best Commons file (low-tide shot, 4032x3024, CC BY-SA) shows the beach as a thin strip at the horizon; the hero crop is mostly blue water and fails recognisability. Needs another photo.

name: Charming Creek Walkway
objection: DOC page opened: now two walkways (North 5.5 km one way, 2 h, to Mangatini Falls; South) because of a slip; mine relics, tunnels. Keep as one spot, bio must say the walk is split.
photo_reason: Swing bridge over the gorge on the walkway (Schwede66, 2018, CC BY-SA 4.0); bridge sits right of centre, hero_crop x 0.65.
coordinates_source: DOC page lists the carpark at the mine site; Wikipedia Hector and Ngakawau -41.6064,171.8806 is the south end. Pick carpark from DOC/OSM before adding.

name: Gillespies Beach

photo_reason: Shingle beach with Aoraki and Mt Tasman at sunset (Tupungato, 2009, CC BY 3.0; file page says Gillespies Beach, South Westland). Colour, wide, subject centred.

name: Scotts Beach

photo_reason: View from Kohaihai Bluff over the beach (public domain, 2013, categorised Scotts Beach, Kahurangi); beach in crop.

name: Ross

name: Victoria Forest Park
objection: Downgraded from keep. For: DOC park page, 206,000 ha, mining relics. Against: a park with no single visitor point or named stop; Waiuta, Big River mine and Reefton walks are the actual stops and are judged separately. Review.
